# Digital Health

> Rust crate of pure calculation functions for digital health KPIs —
> patient engagement/access, digital care operations/safety, and cost and
> revenue. Rate modules are `std`-only: `f64` in and out, `Option<f64>`
> wherever a denominator can be zero. Three cost/revenue modules depend on
> `rusty-money`: `u32` counts and a `Money` amount in, `Result<Money,
> MoneyError>` out.

One module per metric topic. Five mirror a topic in the upstream [Digital
Health
Metrics](https://github.com/digital-health-metrics/digital-health-metrics)
project directly; eight more cover well-evidenced metrics not yet in that
project, sourced independently. Every module has the same shape: what the
metric is, how it's calculated, why it matters, a worked example that runs
as a doctest, data sources and caveats, common pitfalls, and further
reading.

## Docs

- [Crate root](src/lib.rs): module index and a quickstart doctest
- [Specification contracts](spec/README.md): formula, signature, and
  `None`/`Err` condition for every function — the single source of truth
  for "what it computes"
- [README](README.md): install, quickstart, module index, testing
- [Skill](digital-health-skill/SKILL.md): how an AI agent should pick a
  function and read an `Option<f64>` or `Result<Money, MoneyError>` result
  in this crate

## Modules

- [Patient portal adoption rate](src/patient_portal_adoption_rate.rs):
  `registration_rate`, `activation_rate`, `active_use_rate` — three-stage
  funnel over `f64` counts, each `Option<f64>`
- [Telehealth visit rate](src/telehealth_visit_rate.rs):
  `telehealth_visit_rate`, `video_rate`, `telephone_rate`
- [Appointment no-show rate](src/appointment_no_show_rate.rs):
  `no_show_rate`, `late_cancellation_rate`, `combined_non_attendance_rate`
- [Remote patient monitoring adherence rate](src/remote_patient_monitoring_adherence_rate.rs):
  `monitoring_adherence_rate`, `billing_threshold_met_rate`
- [Telehealth technical failure rate](src/telehealth_technical_failure_rate.rs):
  `technical_failure_rate`, `rebooking_rate`
- [Clinical alert override rate](src/clinical_alert_override_rate.rs):
  `override_rate`, `documented_override_rate`
- [Digital referral turnaround time](src/digital_referral_turnaround_time.rs):
  `elapsed_days`, `hours_to_days`, `percentile`
- [Secure messaging response time](src/secure_messaging_response_time.rs):
  `response_hours`, `percentile`
- [E-prescribing transmission accuracy](src/e_prescribing_transmission_accuracy.rs):
  `first_pass_transmission_rate`, `pharmacy_callback_rate`
- [CPOE adoption rate](src/cpoe_adoption_rate.rs):
  `electronic_order_rate`, `verbal_order_rate`
- [No-show lost revenue](src/no_show_lost_revenue.rs) (`Money`, not `f64`):
  `lost_revenue`, `net_revenue_impact`
- [Remote patient monitoring billing revenue](src/remote_patient_monitoring_billing_revenue.rs)
  (`Money`, not `f64`): `billable_revenue`, `revenue_at_risk`
- [Telehealth cost avoidance](src/telehealth_cost_avoidance.rs) (`Money`, not
  `f64`): `cost_avoided`, `net_savings`

## Optional

- [llms.json](llms.json): the same module/function list as structured JSON,
  with formulas and worked-example input/output pairs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): build/test/lint commands and conventions for an
  agent modifying this crate
- [Tutorials](docs/tutorials/): a getting-started walkthrough and a guide to
  adding a new metric module
